critique.evidence: Desktop is visually strong: a disciplined dark grid, bold editorial headline, restrained cyan/coral accents, consistent rounded panels, and clear KPI hierarchy. Tablet preserves the overall system, but chart labels are very small and the recall chart shows a conspicuous gray hover/highlight state that looks visually unfinished. Mobile stacks cleanly, yet typography inside charts becomes cramped, the PR-curve badge crowds its title, and the ablation table is clipped on the right with columns/content disappearing. These responsive polish issues keep it below genuinely demo-ready across all three viewports.
critique.fix: Make the mobile ablation table fully legible via a card/row layout or intentional horizontal-scroll treatment with an affordance; reflow the chart header and badge; increase minimum chart-label sizes while reducing tick density; and suppress captured hover/selection overlays so tablet charts present a clean default state.
